caption.text:
maybe we make it harder than it needs to be.⁠
⁠
maybe the good life⁠
was always small moments,⁠
good people,⁠
a little laughter,⁠
and finding reasons to stay soft.⁠
⁠
here’s to loving deeply,⁠
finding joy where you can,⁠
and embracing this little journey while we have it 🖤
